notes: THREE DIMENSION STATES, all published by Huawei on one line each, height constant at 156.7 mm. (1) FULLY FOLDED / single screen = 156.7 x 73.5 x 12.8 mm -> recorded in dimensions_mm.closed. (2) FULLY UNFOLDED / triple screen = 156.7 x 219.0 x '3.6 mm / 3.6 mm / 4.75 mm' -> recorded in dimensions_mm.open, WITH depth null. (3) INTERMEDIATE SINGLE-FOLDED / dual screen, verbatim from the same Huawei spec row: width 'dual screen: 143.0 mm', depth 'dual screen: 7.45 mm / 4.75 mm', height 156.7 mm; display 'dual screen: 7.9 inches' at 'dual screen: 2232 × 2048 Pixels'. Source for all three states: https://consumer.huawei.com/en/phones/mate-xt-ultimate-design/specs/ (global English page, live, retrieved 2026-09-13). WHY open.depth IS NULL: for the unfolded and single-folded states Huawei publishes a per-panel thickness breakdown ('3.6 mm / 3.6 mm / 4.75 mm'), not one overall depth; picking any one of those three, or the maximum, would be an inference, so depth is null and Huawei's string is preserved verbatim here. The closed state has a single stated depth (12.8 mm) so that one is recorded. Note Huawei's global page has a typo, 'sigle screen', reproduced verbatim in the source quote. Mass: Huawei states 298 g bare and approx. 306 g with the pre-applied screen protector; 298 g recorded. Display: ONE physical flexible panel in three states - recorded as role 'primary' (triple-screen 10.2") plus role 'cover' (single-screen 6.4", the outward-facing face when fully folded); these are the SAME panel, not two panels. 382 PPI, 1.07 billion colours, 1440 Hz PWM dimming, 240 Hz touch sampling. resolution_px preserves Huawei's own ordering (height x width). ANNOUNCED DATE CAVEAT: 2025-02-18 is the GLOBAL launch, per Huawei's own event page ('Kuala Lumpur | 18.02.2025', with 'HUAWEI Mate XT ULTIMATE DESIGN' first under 'What We Announced'). The original China unveiling was earlier - Huawei's China page carries the claim qualifier '截止至 2024 年 9 月 10 日' (as of 10 Sept 2024) for its world-first claim - but no Huawei page I fetched states that as an announcement date, so it is not recorded. released is null: no Huawei page states a retail date. hinge: Huawei states 'The hinge's core components are entirely made of ultra-high strength steel with a strength of 1900 MPa' and describes '26 precision cams'; no angle or free-stop value is published. SUCCESSORS EXIST as of 2026-09-13 - see the prose notes accompanying this array. hinge.axis is NULL on purpose: no manufacturer page states a hinge/fold axis. It is unambiguous from the OEM's own dimension rows (the height stays constant while the width changes between states, so the hinge line runs along the long edge), but deriving it would breach the SPEC rule that active_area_mm is the only derived field.
